name: pin-head-cmd
setup: window.MefiNav.go("command"); await window.MefiIdle.ready(); window.MefiIdle.setOrbit?.("paused", { quiet: true }); const o = window.MefiNodeStyles; window.MefiNodeStyles = Object.freeze({ ...o, tier(r) { return o.tier(r, 3); } }); return true;

name: pin-fix-cmd-outline
setup: window.MefiNav.go("command"); await window.MefiIdle.ready(); window.MefiIdle.setOrbit?.("paused", { quiet: true }); const o = window.MefiNodeStyles; window.MefiNodeStyles = Object.freeze({ ...o, tier(r) { return o.tier(r, 3); } }); const d = window.MefiTreeDynamics, draw = d.outline, real = window.MefiIdle.canvasContext(document.getElementById("idle-layer")); d.outline = (ctx, ...rest) => draw(ctx.canvas instanceof OffscreenCanvas && ctx !== real ? real : ctx, ...rest); return true;
